meaning: Intentionally causing the death of a human being (Qatl-i-amd)
punishment: Death or imprisonment for life and fine
source: PPC 1860 s.302 & CrPC Sched II (amended Act II of 1997)

meaning: Doing an act with intent and capability to cause death
punishment: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine; if hurt caused additional punishment for hurt (minimum 5 years if for honour)

meaning: Causing death of a person without intention by mistake of act or mistake of fact
punishment: Diyat and imprisonment up to 5 years as ta'zir

meaning: Attempting intentional killing with lethal weapon or firearm where victim survives
punishment: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine; additional hurt punishment if injured

meaning: Inflicting physical hurt specifically to the head or face of any person
bailable: Bailable for minor hurt / Non-bailable for bone fractures
punishment: Daman or Arsh and imprisonment ranging from 2 years up to 14 years depending on injury degree
court: Court of Session or Magistrate 1st Class

meaning: Inflicting wound or fracture on body parts other than the head or face
bailable: Bailable for minor hurt / Non-bailable for deep wounds
punishment: Daman and imprisonment ranging from 1 year up to 7 years depending on hurt degree
court: Court of Session or Magistrate 1st Class

meaning: Obstructing a person from moving in any direction where they have a legal right to proceed
punishment: Simple imprisonment up to 1 month or fine up to Rs. 1500 or both (s.341)

meaning: Restraining someone within circumscribing boundaries (locking in room or illegal detention)
punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year or fine up to Rs. 3000 or both (s.342)

meaning: Assaulting or using criminal force against a woman intending to outrage her modesty
punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both
court: Court of Session or Magistrate 1st Class

meaning: Assaulting a woman and stripping her of clothes in public view
punishment: Death or imprisonment for life and fine
source: PPC 1860 s.354A (inserted Ord. VI of 1984) & CrPC Sched II

meaning: Kidnapping a minor under 14 (male) or 16 (female) or person of unsound mind from lawful guardianship
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine
court: Court of Session or Magistrate 1st Class

meaning: Kidnapping or abducting any person with intent secretly and wrongfully to confine them
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine
court: Court of Session or Magistrate 1st Class

meaning: Abducting or kidnapping any person to extort ransom or valuable property for release
punishment: Death or imprisonment for life and forfeiture of property
court: Court of Session or Anti-Terrorism Court

meaning: Taking movable property dishonestly out of possession of any person without consent
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both

meaning: Committing theft inside a residential building house tent or shop
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine
court: Court of Session or Magistrate 1st or 2nd Class

meaning: Theft committed after preparation made for causing death hurt or restraint
punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine
court: Court of Session or Magistrate 1st Class

meaning: Putting a person in fear of injury to dishonestly induce them to deliver property (Bhatta)
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both

meaning: Theft or extortion carried out with force violence or immediate fear of hurt or death
punishment: Rigorous imprisonment 3 to 10 years and fine; up to 14 years if on highway between sunset and sunrise
court: Court of Session or Magistrate Section 30

meaning: Gang robbery committed or attempted conjointly by 5 or more persons
punishment: Imprisonment for life or rigorous imprisonment 4 to 10 years and fine

meaning: Dishonestly converting another person's movable property to one's own use (e.g. keeping found property)
punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both

meaning: Misappropriating or dishonestly using property entrusted to one's custody or management (Amanat me khayanat)
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years or fine or both
court: Court of Session or Magistrate 1st Class

meaning: Dishonestly receiving or retaining property knowing or having reason to believe it is stolen
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both
court: Court of Session or Magistrate 1st or 2nd Class

meaning: Deceiving someone dishonestly to induce them to deliver valuable property or cash (Dhoka/Fraud)
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine
court: Court of Session or Magistrate 1st Class

meaning: Entering into property of another with intent to commit an offence or intimidate insult or annoy (s.447)
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 months or fine up to Rs. 500 or both (s.447)

meaning: Unlawful entry upon land or property with criminal or intimidating intent
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 months or fine up to Rs. 500 or both

meaning: Committing criminal trespass by entering into human dwelling building tent or vessel
punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year or fine up to Rs. 1000 or both

meaning: Dishonestly issuing a bank cheque that bounces due to insufficient funds
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both
source: PPC 1860 s.489-F (amended Ord. LXXXV of 2002) & CrPC Sched II

meaning: Harming reputation of person by spoken/written words or visible representations without statutory exception
punishment: Simple imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both
court: Court of Session or Magistrate 1st Class

meaning: Threatening another person with injury to their person reputation or property (Part I simple / Part II death threat)
bailable: Bailable for Part I / Non-bailable for Part II
compoundable: Compoundable for Part I / Non-compoundable for Part II
punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years or fine (Part I); Imprisonment up to 7 years or fine or both for death threat (Part II)
court: Court of Session or Magistrate 1st Class

meaning: Word gesture act or sexual harassment intended to insult the modesty of a woman
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine up to Rs. 500000 or both
source: PPC 1860 s.509 (substituted Act I of 2010) & CrPC Sched II
